## PART IV — BRING-DOWN OF REPRESENTATIONS & WARRANTIES

### 4.1 Bring-Down Certificate Standard

Per the Merger Agreement, representations and warranties of each party must be true and correct as of the Closing Date with the same force and effect as if made on such date (subject to (i) the materiality / Material Adverse Effect ("MAE") qualifier where expressly applicable, and (ii) the "double materiality scrape" if applicable under the Agreement's indemnification provisions).

### 4.2 Target Bring-Down Checklist

| # | Representation Category | Bring-Down Qualifier | GC Confirmation | Issue / Exception Flag |
|---|------------------------|---------------------|-----------------|------------------------|
| 4.2.1 | **Organization & Qualification** — Target and each subsidiary duly organized, validly existing, in good standing | Accurate in all material respects | ☐ | — |
| 4.2.2 | **Authority & Enforceability** — Board authorization obtained; Agreement is binding; no approvals outstanding | Accurate in all respects (fundamental rep) | ☐ | — |
| 4.2.3 | **Capitalization** — No new issuances, grants, or encumbrances since signing; cap table unchanged | Accurate in all respects (fundamental rep) | ☐ | — |

| 4.2.5 | **Financial Statements** — Audited/reviewed financials fairly present; no restatement | Accurate in all material respects | ☐ | Confirm no new audit adjustments |
